comparator.sourceNotes: External requirements rechecked 2026-10-08. The adopted 2026–2027 OER establishes a 180-EC degree and a complete 60-EC first year. Its second-year learning-line allocations total 60 EC but remain explicitly provisional. Article 9.5 says the third year is still in development; it specifies an18-EC research internship/final work, and Article 9.6 gives26 EC genuine free space. The remaining 16 EC lack a verified required/restricted-choice allocation. The current third-year prospectus has a60-EC heading and a development notice, without a detailed course table; it no longer supplies the previously reported 66-EC calculation. That earlier page description is historical production evidence, not a repeatable current-source claim. Only the supported 164 EC allocation is retained, with provisional learning-line status explicit. No missing courses, weights or formal route are inferred. Linear algebra is3 EC under the controlling OER; a September2026 public-page discrepancy is historical context only. Re-audited25October2026: exactBSc/CROHO59349,fulltime,DutchwithEnglishunits,currentannualOERadopted11June2026effective1September2026. Visiblepp16–18matchtextextraction. audience.programmeDescription: Study how the human brain supports cognition and behaviour, combining biological and psychological knowledge with mathematics, programming, data analysis and neurotechnology. Research projects develop experimental and academic skills.
